spanish: Y dijo Aarón a Moisés: Ay, mi señor, no ahora pongas sobre nosotros pecado que hicimos necedad y que pecamos.

findings.issue: Entreaty particle is rendered as a lament; the plea is omitted and distress is added.
Entreaty particle is rendered as temporal ahora; the plea is omitted and a time point is added.

notes: Speech frame, names, jussive, nosotros, pecado, and both relative clauses match the tokens.
